message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/README.md'
      - '**/CHANGELOG.md'
  pull_request:

jobs:
  unit-test:
    runs-on: ${{matrix.os}}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        jdk: [19, 21, 25]
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up JDK ${{ matrix.jdk }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ matrix.jdk }}
          distribution: temurin

      - name: Install Clojure
        uses: DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure@11.0
        with:
          cli: 1.11.1.1347

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install numpy

      - name: Run tests (jdk<17)
        if: ${{ matrix.jdk < 17 }}
        run: |
          clojure -M:test
      - name: Run tests (jdk>=17)
        if: ${{ matrix.jdk >= 17 }}
        run: |
          clojure -M:jdk-${{matrix.jdk}}:test",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a 45-job matrix and reinstalls pip and numpy in every job with no dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching dominates each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and the measured pip-cache experiment (actions/cache@v4 on ~/.cache/pip) support caching dependency downloads while keeping all installation and tests intact. I added a cache step keyed by runner.os and python-version after setup-python and before install, and removed --no-cache-dir from the numpy install so the restored wheel cache is actually used. This preserves the full matrix, all JDK/Python combinations, both test commands, fail-fast: false, and all triggers/paths; it only avoids re-downloading already-fetched wheels and adds no secrets, privileged actions, deployment, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
